{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", qa_orders.shape[0])
print("QA orders sample:", qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'status', 'revenue_clean']].head())

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print("Number of refunded orders:", refunded.shape[0])

# Filter to completed orders only, as only these contribute to revenue
completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']
print("Number of completed orders:", completed.shape[0])

# Check the channel distribution
print("Channel distribution:", completed['channel'].value_counts())"}
